tools.name: wireframe_guide
tools.description: The tsquare language reference: the text format, the rules, a worked example and every component with its props. Meant to be read once, before the first wireframe; it returns the same text every time.

tools.name: render_wireframe
tools.description: Checks tsquare wireframe text and renders it. Returns a PNG of the board, or, if the text isn't valid, each problem with its line number and the valid options.

tools.name: share_wireframe
tools.description: Links for valid tsquare wireframe text, the same kinds as the playground's Copy link menu: a share link that opens it in the playground for editing, SVG and PNG image links, Markdown and HTML. Returns an SVG image link and the share link unless `links` asks for others. Each link contains the whole w

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: share_wireframe · Public sink: share_wireframe · Destructive: wireframe_guide.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: share_wireframe · Public sink: share_wireframe · Destructive: wireframe_guide

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "wireframe_guide" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "How to write a tsquare wireframe: the text format, the rules, a worked example and every component with its props. Call it once before writing your first wireframe." → after: "The tsquare language reference: the text format, the rules, a worked example and every component with its props. Meant to be read once, before the first wireframe; it returns the same text every time."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
